instruction: Supply Air Duct System IFC This task starts from scratch with no init_file inputs and no local reference images. Create a metric IFC4 supply air duct system and save the required output as /home/user/Desktop/result.ifc. 1. The output folder contains /home/user/Desktop/result.ifc, and /home/user/Desktop/result.ifc is at least 500 bytes. 2. /home/user/Desktop/result.ifc uses an IFC4 schema. 3. The IFC model contains exactly 1 IfcProject, 1 IfcSite, 1 IfcBuilding, 1 IfcBuildingStorey, 3 IfcDuctSegment entities, 2 IfcDuctFitting entities, 2 IfcAirTerminal entities, 1 IfcDistributionSystem, and 1 IfcRelAssignsToGroup relationship. 4. The IFC model contains 0 IfcSpace, 0 IfcWall, 0 IfcSlab, 0 IfcDoor, 0 IfcWindow, 0 IfcBuildingElementProxy, 0 IfcFurniture, 0 IfcRoof, 0 IfcColumn, 0 IfcBeam, and 0 IfcStair entities. 5. All IfcRoot GlobalId values are unique. 6. The single IfcBuildingStorey is named exactly Level 00, ignoring leading and trailing whitespace only. 7. The IfcDistributionSystem is named exactly Supply Air, ignoring leading and trailing whitespace only, and its single IfcRelAssignsToGroup relationship assigns exactly these 7 named elements to the system: Main Segment, Branch Spine, Riser Segment, Transition, Bend, Terminal East, and Terminal North. 8. The IfcDuctSegment names are exactly Main Segment, Branch Spine, and Riser Segment, ignoring leading and trailing whitespace only; their bounding-box dimensions are 2.40 m by 0.40 m by 0.30 m, 1.80 m by 0.35 m by 0.25 m, and 1.80 m by 0.30 m by 0.25 m respectively, in any axis order, with tolerance +/-0.08 m. 9. The IfcDuctFitting names are exactly Transition and Bend, ignoring leading and trailing whitespace only; their bounding-box dimensions are 0.60 m by 0.45 m by 0.35 m and 0.50 m by 0.35 m by 0.35 m respectively, in any axis order, with tolerance +/-0.08 m. 10. The IfcAirTerminal names are exactly Terminal East and Terminal North, ignoring leading and trailing whitespace only; each has bounding-box dimensions 0.45 m by 0.45 m by 0.20 m, in any axis order, with tolerance +/-0.08 m. 11. All duct segments, duct fittings, and air terminals are spatially assigned to Level 00. Any item not explicitly required may vary.
